summary.para: Provides the refresh and persistence operations available to settings UI actions registered through .
提供通过 注册的设置界面操作可用的刷新与持久化功能。
Requests a deferred rebuild of the settings UI, such as after changing a list's structure.
请求延迟重建设置界面，例如在改变列表结构后使用。
Marks a binding as changed so it is saved during the next persistence flush.
将绑定标记为已更改，使其在下一次持久化刷新时保存。

param.name: binding
param.para: The binding whose persisted value changed.
持久化值已更改的绑定。

summary.para: Requests a deferred UI rebuild that also invokes every registered refresh callback on the current page once. Use this after changing several fields or a shared data model in one operation.
This does not schedule persistence. Call for each changed binding that must be saved.
请求延迟重建界面，并在重建时调用当前页面上每个已注册的刷新回调一次。适用于一次操作更改多个字段 或共享数据模型之后。
此方法不会安排持久化；需要保存的每个已更改绑定仍须调用 。
Defines stable IDs for built-in settings menu actions. Extensions may use these IDs by convention, but the registry does not enforce uniqueness.
定义内置设置菜单操作的稳定 ID。扩展可依约定使用这些 ID，但注册表不会强制其唯一。
Resets a binding to its default value.
将绑定重置为默认值。
Copies the current value to a clipboard envelope.
将当前值复制到剪贴板信封。
Pastes a value from a clipboard envelope into a binding.
将剪贴板信封中的值粘贴到绑定。
Moves a list item up.
向上移动列表项。
Moves a list item down.
向下移动列表项。
Duplicates a list item.
复制列表项。
Removes a list item.
移除列表项。
Copies all setting snapshots on a page.
复制页面中的全部设置快照。
Pastes setting snapshots into an entire page.
将设置快照粘贴到整个页面。
Resets every binding with a default value on a settings page.
重置设置页面中每个具有默认值的绑定。
Copies all setting snapshots in one section.
复制一个节中的全部设置快照。
Pastes setting snapshots into one section.
将设置快照粘贴到一个节。
Resets every binding with a default value in a settings section.
重置设置节中每个具有默认值的绑定。

Registers callbacks that append custom actions to menus for setting rows, list items, pages, and sections. Each menu build invokes a stable registration snapshot outside the registry lock; callbacks registered during that invocation participate in later builds. Appender exceptions propagate.
注册向设置行、列表项、页面与节菜单追加自定义操作的回调。每次构建菜单时都会在注册表锁外调用稳定的注册快照； 调用期间新增的回调从后续构建开始生效。追加回调抛出的异常会继续传播。

param.para: The callback that receives the host, target binding, and mutable action list when a menu is built.
构建菜单时接收宿主、目标绑定与可变操作列表的回调。

构建菜单时接收宿主、目标页面上下文与可变操作列表的回调。

构建菜单时接收宿主、目标节上下文与可变操作列表的回调。

summary.para: Registers a callback for full-pass UI refreshes. This is equivalent to calling with the default full-pass specification and preserves compatibility with extensions built against older RitsuLib versions.
注册用于完整遍历界面刷新的回调。该方法等同于使用默认的完整遍历规范调用 ，并保留对旧版 RitsuLib 扩展的兼容性。
Registers a UI-refresh callback selected by against bindings marked dirty since the previous refresh flush.
注册界面刷新回调； 会与上一次刷新队列执行后标记为脏的绑定进行匹配。
Registers a Godot control whose visibility predicate is reevaluated on every debounced refresh. This supports sidebar controls outside the main content refresh graph.
注册一个 Godot 控件，在每次防抖刷新时重新计算其可见性谓词。用于主内容刷新图之外的侧边栏控件。

Allows a binding to propagate to related bindings so selective refresh and autosave observe the same invalidation. Examples include a projected field and its list root, or a decorator and its inner binding.
允许绑定将 传播到相关绑定，使选择性刷新和自动保存观察到 相同的失效关系，例如投影字段与列表根绑定，或装饰器与内部绑定。
Identifies bindings that participate in UI refresh invalidation as one equivalent group.
标识在界面刷新失效判断中视为同一等价组的绑定。
Gets other binding instances treated as the same selective-refresh target, such as the inner binding wrapped by a settings binding decorator.
获取在选择性刷新中视为同一目标的其他绑定实例，例如 设置绑定装饰器所包装的内部绑定。
Declares when a registered settings UI refresh callback runs, based on bindings marked dirty since the previous refresh flush.
根据上一次刷新队列执行后被标记为脏的绑定，声明已注册的设置界面刷新回调何时运行。
Declares when a registered settings UI refresh callback runs, based on bindings marked dirty since the previous refresh flush.
根据上一次刷新队列执行后被标记为脏的绑定，声明已注册的设置界面刷新回调何时运行。
Displays the full-screen mod settings browser, including its mod, page, and section sidebar and its settings content pane.
显示全屏模组设置浏览器，包括模组、页面与节侧边栏以及设置内容窗格。
Delay between the most recent binding write and the deferred call.
最近一次绑定写入与延迟调用 之间的间隔。
Debounce interval for refreshing mirrored and other dynamic display content. It remains longer than so the refresh observes persistence and custom side effects from the same edit.
刷新镜像内容及其他动态显示内容的防抖间隔。该值保持大于 ， 使刷新能够观察到同一次编辑所产生的持久化结果与自定义 副作用。
Creates the header, sidebar, and scrollable content layout and initializes their structural connections.
创建标题、侧边栏与可滚动内容布局，并初始化其结构连接。
Selects and exclusively expands a mod in the sidebar, optionally selects one of its pages, and refreshes the UI.
在侧边栏中选择并仅展开指定模组，可选择其中一个页面，然后刷新界面。

param.name: modId
param.para: The ID of the mod to select.
要选择的模组 ID。

param.name: pageId
param.para: The optional ID of the page to select.
要选择的可选页面 ID。

summary.para: Selects a page within the current mod and refreshes the UI. The request is ignored when no mod is selected.
在当前模组中选择页面并刷新界面；未选择模组时忽略该请求。

param.name: pageId
param.para: The ID of the page to select.
要选择的页面 ID。

summary.para: Selects a page and section within the current mod, then scrolls the selected section into view and updates focus navigation. The request is ignored when no mod is selected.
在当前模组中选择页面与节，然后将所选节滚动到可见区域并更新焦点导航； 未选择模组时忽略该请求。

param.name: pageId
param.para: The ID of the page that contains the section.
节所在页面的 ID。

param.name: sectionId
param.para: The ID of the section to reveal.
要显示的节 ID。
